name: offers, arguments and guarded recovery
source:
on t
try
 put 1 into x
offer skip
offer useValue value, extra
 put value + extra into x
catch e before unwind where true
 choose offer skip
 choose offer skip()
 choose offer useValue([1, 2], 3)
catch e
 say e
finally
 say x
end try
end t

name: offer without catch and nested shadowing
source:
on t
try
offer skip
 try
 offer skip
 end try
end try
end t

name: dynamic availability and local loops
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 repeat 2 times
  if true then choose offer unknown(1)
  next repeat
  exit repeat
 end repeat
end try
end t

name: ordinary names choose and unwind
source:
on t
choose 1
put unwind into x
end t
on choose value
end choose
constant unwind = 1

name: quoted offer map key
source:
on t
put {"offer": 1} into x
end t

name: duplicate offers
source:
on t
try
offer skip
offer skip
end try
end t

source:

name: offer parameter binding clash
source:

constant x = 1

name: choice outside recovery
source:
on t

end t

name: choice in ordinary catch
source:

try
catch e

name: choice permission resets in lambda
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 put given
  choose offer skip
 end given into f
end try
end t

name: lambda own recovery grants permission
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 put given
  try
  catch inner before unwind
   choose offer skip
  end try
 end given into f
end try
end t

name: function cannot inherit recovery
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 put helper() into x
end try
end t
function helper
 choose offer skip
end helper

source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 try
 finally

end t

name: transitive handler suspension
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind

end try
end t
on middle

end middle
on sleeper

end sleeper

source:

try
catch e before unwind
 put middle() into x
end try
end t

end middle
function sleeper
 wait 1 s
end sleeper

spaced choice call

end value

offer skip value

source:

name: cleanup has its own recovery and offer
source:
on t
try
finally
 try
 offer skip
 catch e before unwind
  choose offer skip
 end try
end try
end t

name: finally return keeps both exit restrictions
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind
 try
 finally

 end try
end try
end t

name: external loop exit through nested cleanup
source:
on t
repeat 2 times
 try
 catch e before unwind
  try
  finally
   next repeat
  end try
 end try
end repeat
end t

name: recovery Guard keeps ordinary restrictions
source:
on t
try
catch e before unwind where middle()
end try
end t
function middle
wait 1 s
end middle
